groups.name: memory
groups.description: LanceDB-backed AI memory experiments for Lua skills.

tools.name: vulcan-ai-memory-lancedb-test
tools.description: Verify the host-managed LanceDB binding for vulcan-ai-memory by creating a demo table, upserting one vector row, and performing one vector search.

parameters.name: table_name
parameters.description: Optional table name used for the test run. Defaults to ai_memory_test.

parameters.name: record_id
parameters.description: Optional stable record id. Defaults to memory-test-001.

parameters.name: memory_text
parameters.description: Optional memory text stored alongside the embedding. Defaults to a stable bilingual test sentence.

parameters.name: overwrite_if_exists
parameters.description: Whether to overwrite the demo table if it already exists. Defaults to true for a stable test loop.

tools.prompt: Use this to verify that the current skill receives a working host-managed LanceDB instance under __lancedb/vulcan-ai-memory.
